name: SN Primo field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant supernova SN Primo, seen by Hubble.
label: primo-hubble
story: In this deep patch of the Hubble Ultra Deep Field, CANDELS imaging caught a Type Ia supernova at redshift 1.55, nicknamed SN Primo, flaring in a strongly star-forming galaxy. Hubble came back to the field to follow it.

claims.text: SN Primo is a Type Ia supernova at redshift 1.55
The supernova was nicknamed SN Primo
It was discovered in CANDELS imaging of the Hubble Ultra Deep Field
Its host is a strongly star-forming galaxy
Program 12099 was Hubble follow-up of high-redshift supernovae, with PRIMO as a target
The SN Primo paper acknowledges program HST-GO-12099
